Aucun minuteur : choisis une durée ci-de: No timer: choose a duration above.
Plusieurs minuteurs en même temps : sais: Several timers at once: enter a duration up to 99 hours or pick a ready-made one (1 min to 1 h), add a name if you like, and each timer gets its own card with an emptying ring, pause, resume, reset and delete. When time is up: three beeps, a notification and a blinking card. The countdown goes on even with the tab closed.
